patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,25 @@
-def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
-    pass
+def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
+    result = []
+    
+    for i in range(start, start - take, -1):
+        if i > 1:
+            line1 = f"{i} bottles of beer on the wall, {i} bottles of beer."
+            if i > 2:
+                line2 = f"Take one down and pass it around, {i-1} bottles of beer on the wall."
+            else:  # i == 2
+                line2 = f"Take one down and pass it around, {i-1} bottle of beer on the wall."
+        elif i == 1:
+            line1 = f"{i} bottle of beer on the wall, {i} bottle of beer."
+            line2 = "Take it down and pass it around, no more bottles of beer on the wall."
+        else:  # i == 0
+            line1 = "No more bottles of beer on the wall, no more bottles of beer."
+            line2 = "Go to the store and buy some more, 99 bottles of beer on the wall."
+        
+        result.append(line1)
+        result.append(line2)
+        
+        # Add empty line between verses except for the last verse
+        if i > start - take + 1:
+            result.append("")
+    
+    return result
